steps.what: List stored changes to environmental standards or regulations
Review or modify policies or operating guidelines to comply

tasks.design: The manager reviews or modifies policies or operating guidelines to comply with changes to environmental standards or regulations. {DOCS} only lists change notices the manager has already saved. A blank notice stays blank. The manager still reviews and modifies the policy, at full effort. The list does not rewrite the policy. The rules are those in force.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager found the change and edited the policy.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved notices can be listed. Editing the policy stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: How a policy should change stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not treat a missing notice as a change.
tasks.altitude: The notice list is clerical. Reviewing and modifying the policy stay at full effort.

reach.task: Use only the policy text the manager has modified

evidence.claim: Saved change notices can be listed. Modifying a policy to meet them stays manual.
Whether a policy meets an environmental rule in force is a legal conclusion about that text and that rule.

assumptions: The work starts with the policy and ends when the manager has modified it, or stops.
A change notice has identifier, date, and summary, saved by the manager. A blank summary is left blank and is not invented.
The list does not edit the policy. The manager writes any change.
unknowns: Which notices the manager has saved, and which are still unread.
research_questions: How often was a notice summary blank?

already_counted.description: Reviewing and modifying the policy is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a notice summary before the list is used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: notices are often blank, so the manager still reads the change from the source. High: notices are saved, the list is shown, and the manager still modifies the policy. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review communications such as securities sales advertising
Ensure there are no violations of standards or regulations

tasks.design: The manager reviews communications such as securities sales advertising to ensure there are no violations of standards or regulations. The review stays at full effort. A rule does not declare a violation. The rules are those in force.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager read the advertising and decided.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the text violates a rule stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not mark a violation the text does not show.
tasks.altitude: The review stays at full effort. A violation is not declared by a rule.

reach.task: Change the text only after the manager says so

evidence.claim: Reviewing securities advertising for a violation stays with the manager, because it depends on the text.
Whether a securities advertisement violates a rule in force is a legal conclusion about that text and that rule.

assumptions: The brief is the advertisement the manager is reading. A blank text is left blank.
No violation is invented. Upkeep is zero. The rules are those in force.
Sending the advertisement is a different task.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every advertisement is still reviewed by the manager. High: the same review remains, with no violation declared by a rule. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Oversee internal reporting systems such as corporate compliance hotlines
Read what a person took down only after the call

tasks.design: The manager oversees internal reporting systems, such as corporate compliance hotlines. Oversight stays at full effort. The hotline already receives calls. That running system is not counted as saved labour. A report is not triaged by a rule. Callers are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager oversaw the hotline and read what a person had taken down.
tasks.enabler_now: The hotline already runs. That is not new saved labour.
tasks.still_hard: What to do with a report stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not act on a report a person has not read back.
tasks.altitude: Oversight stays at full effort. The running hotline is not saved labour.

reach.task: Reach a person, then the manager
reach.learn: Which calls were not read back.

evidence.claim: Overseeing a compliance hotline stays with the manager. The hotline already running is not saved labour.

assumptions: The brief is the note a person took from the call. The hotline already receives calls.
That running reception is not counted as saved labour. Callers are not scored. Upkeep is zero.
A blank note is left blank and is not invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every hotline is still overseen by the manager. High: the same oversight remains, and the running hotline is not counted as saved labour. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List required areas with no software technology on the row
Verify software technology is in place to provide oversight
Judge whether that monitoring covers the area adequately

tasks.design: The manager verifies that software technology is in place to adequately provide oversight and monitoring in all required areas. {DOCS} only lists a required area whose stored system name is blank. A blank area identifier stops the list. The manager still verifies and judges adequacy, at full effort. The list does not say the monitoring is adequate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager checked the register and then judged the coverage.
tasks.enabler_now: A blank system name can be listed. Judging adequacy stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the monitoring is adequate stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a list that treats a blank area as covered.
tasks.altitude: The gap list is clerical. Verification and the adequacy judgement stay at full effort.

reach.task: Name the system the manager asks about

evidence.claim: A required area with a blank system name can be listed. Judging whether monitoring is adequate stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with the area register and ends when the manager has judged adequacy, or stops.
An area row has area identifier and system name, entered by the manager. A blank area identifier stops the list. A blank system name is listed as a gap and is not invented.
The list does not judge adequacy. No product is chosen here.
unknowns: Which areas the manager has marked as required.
research_questions: How often was an area identifier blank?

already_counted.description: Judging adequacy is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct an area row before the list is used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: area rows are often blank, so the manager still checks coverage by hand. High: rows are complete, the gaps are listed, and the manager still judges adequacy. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The compliance manager still judges a breach, a sanction, and a policy change. A policy or a report is sent or filed only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An employee reaches the manager directly with a confidential report.
A colleague receives only a policy the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required flag, interval, or figure is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep investigations, sanctions, and policy changes in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every management report traces to a stored figure, and the manager still writes what it means.
